payout_quote: Official checking offer page: $100 bonus on new Convenience Checking, $300 bonus on new Bankohana Level I Checking — with $500 opening deposit and qualifying direct deposits totaling $2,000+ (Convenience) or $3,500+ (Bankohana Level I) within 60 days of account opening.
timing: Statement credit applied within 120 days of account opening date.
steps: Go to https://www.boh.com/personal/bank-accounts/pr/checking-offer/ and choose the tier: Convenience Checking ($100 bonus) or Bankohana Level I ($300 bonus).
Open the new checking account with a $500 initial deposit.
Set up qualifying direct deposits totaling $2,000+ (Convenience) or $3,500+ (Bankohana Level I) within 60 days of account opening.
Keep the account open; the bonus is applied as a statement credit within 120 days of the account opening date (reported on 1099-INT).
catches: New checking-account bonus only (new customers / new accounts).
Requires $500 initial opening deposit plus qualifying direct deposits totaling $2,000+ (Convenience, $100) or $3,500+ (Bankohana Level I, $300) within 60 days of opening.
Statement credit lands within 120 days of account opening — slow payout.
Availability is Hawaii-focused; bonus reported on 1099-INT.
The old $400 tier (Bankohana II/III) was discontinued ~July 2026 per aggregators — official page now shows only $100/$300 tiers; do not present a $400 figure.
biggest_catch: The bonus tiers scale with the account: only $100 on the basic Convenience Checking — the $300 requires the Bankohana Level I account and $3,500 in direct deposits within 60 days.
eligibility: New Bank of Hawaii checking customers; Hawaii-focused availability; 18+.
